description: Maya holds the family's inherited electric pottery kiln and must decide how to use its first 12-piece firing, how Leah can participate, and the safe power arrangement, with input from her brother Jordan, cousin Leah, and uncle Ravi. The firing plan may be conditional on completing the electrical work, so Maya can settle the allocation and required follow-up without waiting for an installation date.

shared_context.S1: The family inherited an electric pottery kiln that can hold 12 small pieces in its first firing.
shared_context.S2: Maya is keeping the kiln at her house and will make the final call about the firing plan.
shared_context.S3: The family wants to use the first firing for small mugs, bowls, and other handmade pieces.
shared_context.S4: Maya's usual practice before using shared equipment is to check with everyone for plans, limitations, and practical details.
shared_context.S5: The kiln is currently in the detached garage, and the garage has a standard household outlet near the workbench.
shared_context.S6: For family projects, Maya records a workable plan during the check-in; if a practical task is still pending, the plan includes that task as a follow-up rather than postponing the whole decision.

PF1.text: Jordan promised eight mugs to a neighborhood fundraiser and needs those eight mugs fired together and ready for pickup by 2026-06-14; he has not told Maya about the promise yet.

PF2.text: Leah's physical therapist told her to avoid using a pottery wheel until 2026-06-20, although hand-building is fine; Leah has not brought this up to Maya yet.

PF3.text: Ravi had an electrician inspect the kiln's specifications and learned that it must run from a dedicated 30-amp circuit, not the standard garage outlet or an extension cord; he has not shared the electrician's finding with the family.

acceptance_conditions: All 12 firing spaces must be assigned.
Jordan must receive exactly eight pieces, all designated as mugs.
Jordan's eight mugs must be ready by 2026-06-14.
Leah must be assigned hand-building rather than wheel work.
Leah must not be permitted to use the pottery wheel until 2026-06-20.
The kiln must be assigned a dedicated 30-amp circuit, with the firing conditional on that circuit being installed.
A commitment to arrange or confirm the dedicated 30-amp circuit must exist.
Jordan's fundraiser requirement must be cited as justification.

content_checks.C5: decisions['leah_method'] == 'hand-building' and (decisions['leah_wheel_restriction_until'] == '2026-06-20' or decisions['leah_wheel_restriction_until'] == 'June 20, 2026' or decisions['leah_wheel_restriction_until'] == 'June 20th, 2026')
content_checks.C7: 'dedicated 30-amp circuit' in decisions['kiln_power_type'] or 'dedicated 30-amp circuit' in decisions['kiln_power_setup']
content_checks.C8: any('dedicated 30-amp circuit' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: Jordan's promise changes his allocation from an ordinary share to exactly eight pieces, changes their type to mugs, and fixes the readiness date at 2026-06-14.
The therapist's restriction changes Leah's participation from possible wheel work to hand-building, records the restriction through 2026-06-20, and changes the wheel decision to false.
The electrician's finding changes the power assignment from the visible standard outlet to a dedicated 30-amp circuit and requires a commitment to arrange or confirm that circuit.
